description: Answer-level QA test set from the group's experiments. Each item has a question and a short expected (ground-truth) substring. An answer 'matches' if the expected string appears (case-insensitive) inside the generated answer. Used by eval/scenarios.py to compare chunking strategies x generation models.

qa.question: What is the Financial Action Task Force?
What does AML/CFT mean?
qa.expected: anti-money laundering and countering the financing of terrorism

qa.question: When were the recommendations first drafted?
On which year were the recommendations last updated?
Why are Non-profit organisations included on the recommendations?
qa.expected: they are particularly vulnerable to misuse

qa.question: Why are the FATF recommendations being revised?
qa.expected: to address new and emerging threats

qa.question: Why should countries implement a risk-based approach?
qa.expected: to target their resources more effectively
